name: Knaves
ability: There are 2 Storytellers: one lies & one tells the truth. Once per game, at dusk, they might switch.
setup: The two Storytellers decide before the first night which tells the truth and which lies.
interaction: Whenever a player receives ability information (at night or visiting during the day) they choose which Storyteller gives it. Once per game at dusk, if both agree, the roles swap.
drunk_or_poisoned: If the receiving player is drunk or poisoned, either Storyteller may tell the truth or lie.

rulings.text: Rules and non-ability information (nominations, Demon bluffs, Minion info) are always truthful.
The swap happens at dusk and requires both Storytellers to agree.
The wiki classifies it as Loric rather than Fabled.

test_scenarios.name: lying Storyteller
test_scenarios.actions: Night 1: Alice picks the lying Storyteller.

test_scenarios.name: truthful Storyteller
test_scenarios.setup: Knaves; Alice Empath with one evil neighbour.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 2: Alice picks the truthful Storyteller.

test_scenarios.name: after swap
test_scenarios.actions: Dusk of day 2: the Storytellers swap. Day 3: Alice visits the now-lying one.

test_scenarios.name: Demon bluffs always true
test_scenarios.expected: The bluffs are characters genuinely not in play.
